snippet.title: Play All Day ...and Night! | Club Penguin Zero Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Play Club Penguin all day... and night!

Introducing the Day & Night cycle exclusively on Club Penguin Zero! Every four hours is a full rotation of morning, midday, evening and night!

This also means new elements for parties, but we'll cover that another time...

Club Penguin Zero releases October 24th! Stay tuned for more news and information at www.cpzero.net!

Check it out! - https://www.cpzero.net/
Twitter -   https://twitter.com/CPZeroOfficial
Discord -   https://discord.gg/N8sEcSdzwc
